name_note: GTDB places genomes named [Clostridium] symbiosum (and one Clostridium fessum) in Otoolea symbiosa; the literature uses the name Clostridium symbiosum.

sentences.text: Clostridium symbiosum has been described as a short-chain fatty acid producer, and gut microbiome composition has been reported to influence stroke outcomes.
A study measured the relative abundance of fecal Clostridium symbiosum by qPCR in controls, colorectal adenoma patients, and early and advanced colorectal cancer patients.
A study reported a stepwise increase of C. symbiosum abundance across adenoma, early and advanced colorectal cancer, and proposed it as a noninvasive detection biomarker.
Its NAD+-linked glutamate dehydrogenase has been studied structurally, with reports describing a hexameric enzyme whose subunits form two domains separated by a deep cleft.
